title: Application settings: schema, effective config, masking
interface: SETTINGS_SCHEMA: list of dicts {key, label (Czech), group (Czech: 'Obecné', 'Přihlášení Microsoft 365 (Entra ID)', 'E-mail (SMTP)', 'HR synchronizace (Drupal)'), type ('str'|'int'|'bool'|'choice'|'json'|'text'), secret (bool), choices (list, for type choice), help (Czech)}. Keys: COMPANY_NAME, BASE_URL, PROTOCOL_COPY_TO, HANDOVER_TOKEN_HOURS (int); AUTH_MODE (choice dev/oidc), OIDC_TENANT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET (secret); EMAIL_MODE (choice outbox/smtp), EMAIL_FROM, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT (int), SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD (secret), SMTP_STARTTLS (bool); DRUPAL_URL, DRUPAL_AUTH_MODE (choice none/basic/token), DRUPAL_USER, DRUPAL_PASSWORD (secret), DRUPAL_TOKEN (secret), DRUPAL_FIELD_MAP (json text), DRUPAL_FILTER (str). class SettingsService(repo: SettingsRepository) with class attribute MASK = '••••••••'. effective(base: dict) -> dict: copy of base with every stored setting applied, coerced by type (int -> int(), bool -> value in ('1','true','yes','on') case-insensitively, json -> the raw JSON text string kept as-is, others str). save(values: dict, updated_by) -> None: for each key in SETTINGS_SCHEMA present in values: if secret and value == MASK skip (keep stored); if value == '' delete the stored key; else repo.set(key, str(value)). validate(values: dict) -> list[str] of problems formatted 'KEY: message' (int keys must parse and, for HANDOVER_TOKEN_HOURS and SMTP_PORT, be > 0; choice keys must be in choices; json keys must parse as a JSON object; unknown keys ignored). for_form(base: dict) -> list[dict]: one row per schema item with key, label, group, type, secret, choices, help and value = MASK when secret and a stored value exists, else the stored value, else str(base.get(key, '')) (booleans as '1'/'0'). Never catch generic Exception.
